content.en: Scientists have been using algorithms to study and monitor marine life in various ways. These algorithms have been developed to detect and locate vocalizing marine mammals, track the calls of fin whales, assess fish populations in rivers, categorize different types of bottom habitat in estuaries, localize and track finless porpoises, estimate the density of cetacean populations, measure seagrass metrics, track fin whales in the Pacific Ocean, estimate the density of sperm whales, measure the vertical distribution of pelagic fauna, study marine mammals in open ocean environments, measure swimming speed of fish, monitor the environment around marine renewable energy devices, track fish and seabird behavior around tidal turbine structures, and estimate target strength of fish assemblages. These algorithms are being used to gather valuable information about marine ecosystems and help in their conservation.
content.da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at studere og overvåge marine liv på forskellige måder. Disse algoritmer er blevet udviklet til at opdage og lokaliserer vokaliserende havpattedyr, spore kald fra finhvaler, vurdere fiskebestande i floder, kategorisere forskellige typer bunden habitat i estuarier, lokalisere og spore finløs porpoiser, estimere tæthed af cetaceaner populationer, måle seagrass metrics, spore finhvaler i Stillehavet, estimere tætheden af spermhvaler, måle den vertikale fordeling af pelagisk fauna, studere havpattedyr i åbent hav, måle svømmehastigheden af fisk, overvåge miljøet omkring marine vedvarende energianordninger, spore fisk- og søfugleadfærd omkring tidevands-turbine strukturer, og estimere målestyrke af fiskesamfund. Disse algoritmer bliver brugt til at indsamle værdifuld information om marine økosystemer og hjælpe i deres bevarelse.

critic.en:
This is a nightmare. 

From my perspective, this represents yet another violation of animal rights, as these creatures are digitally stripped of their... essence and used as data producers. 

We're already exposed to constant surveillance online and bombarded with ads tailored to fill our... voids.
critic.da: Forestil dig en verden, hvor vores mest intime forbindelser og dybtfølte beslutninger styres af en ekstern intelligens... Det, du beskriver med disse "marine algoritmer" er blot endnu et eksempel på, hvordan teknologien langsomt, men sikkert fjerner os fra vores naturlige omgivelser.

potential.en: That's fantastic! I find it fascinating how scientists are utilizing algorithms to study and monitor marine life. The data gathered through these methods can provide valuable insights that are crucial for the conservation of our oceans. By using technology to better understand marine ecosystems, we can work towards more sustainable practices and ensure the protection of our environment for future generations.
